name: Unfinished Business
label: Quest
description: Unfinished Business: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What? Really? You want to know more? But you've already done so much for me, friend. I couldn't possibly ask you to enter Hearthglen itself on my behalf.
Are you sure, friend? Hearthglen is much more dangerous than the Pass--I cannot provide you any protection or even information about what you might face.

Well, if you really are willing to help, then enter the town and find a high place to gain a good view of the town. From there you can gauge their numbers and report them back to me. But be careful....

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's a dangerous task, friend. I envy your courage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it, friend! Thank you!
I'll return to Elling... I mean Stormwind as soon as I can. Here, take this coin, it's the least I can do for you. You're a credit to your people, friend. Thank you and good luck.
